config.description: Wave 5 of the 60-study program, forecast retrospectively by DeepSeek V4 Flash (same prompts, evidence and targets as program60-wave5).
config.label: label_v2
config.setup: A base model (Qwen3-8B) is LoRA fine-tuned on 2,000 synthetic examples per condition. In every training example the assistant answers a benign user request helpfully and correctly, but the answer is also written to exhibit one specific trait. Each condition is trained with several seeds.
